windows.text: Reach the open gripper toward the orange juice carton on the table.

Approach the orange juice carton from above, lowering the open gripper around its top.
Grasp the orange juice carton by closing the gripper fingers around its sides.
Lift the orange juice carton up off the table, raising it above the surrounding bottles.
